_doc: Good Stock breeding (core/breeding.gd, docs/design/2026-10-21-breeding.md section 4). 'goals' are the three conservation goals: 'line' is the evolution line (a data/genes.json line), 'need' how many bred creatures of that line (born at the farm, not caught, from a pure same-line pairing) you must hold in the party or Ark, 'rule' what the group must also be: 'spread' (no more than two from any one pairing, and at least three pairings: a flock is not one family), 'pairings' (the young come from at least 'pairs' unrelated pairings) or 'pure' (no hybrid blood). 'base' and 'per_badge' are the breed society's one-off grant in sterling pounds: base + per_badge x badges. 'nation' is where the standing goes (the dialogue pays it).
